messages:
maya: quick postmortem note: during last-night drain a few tenants experienced cross-region write attempts despite residency=EU-only. latency rippled.
rahul: looked at proxy traces: cache miss + fallback policy chose next region. TTLs expired during heavy regen.
clare: immediate fix: proxy will treat cache-miss as deny for cross-region writes (config toggle). less blast radius than sync CP fetch.
ines: legal insists default-on deny for PII. any change must be auditable.
maya: ops runbook tweak: prewarm residency cache and pre-issue short-lived signed tokens for tenants that allow fallback. script to run before drains.
clare: longer-term RFC: signed residency token issued by CP (5m TTL), validated in proxy. token fields: tenant_id|consent|allowed_regions|exp|sig. avoids CP sync on steady state. include revocation pattern (short token life + revocation list).
ines: ok if audit events show token issuance and revocations, and UI records consent history.
rahul: metrics to add: residency.cache_miss_blocked_total, residency.token_validation_failures_total, residency.fallback_blocked_per_tenant. alert on >5/min blocked per tenant.
clare: deploy-bot: canary rolling residency_cache_miss_default=deny scheduled eu-canary 2024-06-10T09:00Z (10%->50%->100%).
maya: will monitor p99 and blocked counters during canary. if sticky failures appear we revert quickly.
clare: i'll file a short RFC + runbook fragment and tag legal + ops.
deploy-bot: RFC created https://go.redwood/rfcs/1291 by clare.
maya: thanks all, sync tomorrow 11:30 PT to review canary metrics.
